description: User requests to the Supervisor, each with the route a careful reader would take. `route` is `job_search` (planned and handed to the Job Search subgraph) or `clarify` (asked back). `domain` is the domain the request is really about, checked when set: a clarify for an unsupported domain should still name the right one. Synthetic.
